## 1. データ読み込み

```{r}
# ================================================================================
# 0. 初期設定・パッケージ読み込み
# ================================================================================
library(here)
library(haven)
library(labelled)
library(glmnet)
library(tidyverse)
# library(fastDummies)
library(nnet)      # 多項ロジスティック回帰
library(survey)    # 重み付き統計解析
library(did)       # Staggered DID用（必要に応じて）
library(sjlabelled)　# ラベル付きデータ処理用
library(tableone)
library(fixest)   # 回帰分析の推定結果から係数表（推定値、標準誤差、t値、p値など）を抽出

# オブジェクトクリア
rm(list = ls(all = TRUE))

# 自作関数読み込み
source("../myTools.R")

# ================================================================================
# 1. データ読み込み
# ================================================================================
# DHSデータのルートフォルダを指定
gdrive_dir <- "/Users/snakada/Library/CloudStorage/GoogleDrive-snakada@g.ecc.u-tokyo.ac.jp/マイドライブ/Peru_work/Peru_endes/spss"

gdrive__dir_enaho <- "/Users/snakada/Library/CloudStorage/GoogleDrive-snakada@g.ecc.u-tokyo.ac.jp/マイドライブ/Peru_work/Peru_enaho"

# 結果保存先
save_path <- file.path(gdrive_dir, "output")

# データベース一覧
endes_list <- readRDS(file.path(gdrive_dir, "output","endes_data_list.rds"))

# 変数ラベル一覧
endes_var_labels <- readRDS(file.path(gdrive_dir, "output", "endes_var_labels.rds"))



# ================================================================================
# 1. データ読み込み
# ================================================================================

df_org <- readRDS(
  file.path(gdrive_dir, "output", "all_data_merged.rds")
)

# ================================================================================
# 2. 介入前データ抽出
# ================================================================================

df_pre <- df_org[df_org$treated_status %in% c("never_treated", "not_yet_treated"), ]

# treatment_group定義
df_pre <- df_pre %>%
  mutate(
    treatment_group = case_when(
      treatment_start == "2009" ~ 1,  # 早期介入
      treatment_start == "2011" ~ 2,  # 後期介入
      TRUE ~ 0                        # コントロール
    ),
    treatment_group = as.factor(treatment_group)
  )

cat("介入前データの群別サンプル数:\n")
print(table(df_pre$treatment_group))

# ================================================================================
# 3. PSM共変量選択（メディエーター除外版）
# ================================================================================

# Con変数を明示的に定義（30個）
con_vars <- c(
  # Health status (4)
  "ch_below_2p5", "nt_wm_ht", "nt_wm_any_anem", "nt_wm_ovobese",
  
  # Health service (4)
  "rh_anc_pvskill", "rh_anc_urine", "rh_prob_minone", "nt_wm_micro_dwm",
  
  # Water & hygiene (3)
  "ph_sani_improve_dummy", "ph_wtr_improve_dummy", "ph_wtr_far",
  
  # Social environment (4)
  "dm_hh_head_30plus", "rc_edu_acceptable", "dm_child_more_than3", "ms_afm_15",
  
  # Assets (11)
  "dm_weath_index", "ph_electric", "ph_mobile", "ph_radio", "ph_moto",
  "rc_agri_yes", "dm_cattle_own", "dm_sheeep_own", "dm_ag_land_ha",
  "dm_cooking_fuel_traditional"
)

# アウトカム変数
outcome_vars <- c("nt_ch_stunt", "nt_ch_haz")

# メディエーター変数（PSMから除外）
mediator_vars <- c(
  "re_anc_4vs", "rh_anc_4mo", "nt_bf_start_1hr",
  "dm_sani_open_yes", "ch_stool_safe_no", "ph_wtr_trt_none",
  "nt_mdd", "nt_grains", "nt_root", "nt_nuts", "nt_meatfish",
  "nt_milk", "nt_dairy", "nt_eggs", "nt_vita", "nt_frtveg"
)

# PSM用共変量（メディエーターを除外）
covariate_names <- con_vars



```


## 2. 多項GLM-PSM（介入前データで学習）

```{r}


# ================================================================================
# 4. データ整合性チェック
# ================================================================================

# メディエーター混入チェック
stopifnot(!any(mediator_vars %in% covariate_names))
cat("✓ メディエーター混入なし確認\n")

# データ内に存在する変数のみ抽出
existing_covariates <- intersect(covariate_names, names(df_pre))
missing_covariates <- setdiff(covariate_names, names(df_pre))

if(length(missing_covariates) > 0) {
  cat("警告: 以下の変数がデータに存在しません:\n")
  print(missing_covariates)
}

cat("PSM共変量: ", length(existing_covariates), "個（期待: 30個）\n")

# 最終的なPSM共変量
covariate_names <- existing_covariates

# ================================================================================
# 5. 欠損値処理
# ================================================================================

# NA値の多い列を除去（10%以上NA）
keep_cols <- covariate_names[
  sapply(df_pre[, covariate_names], function(x) sum(is.na(x)) <= nrow(df_pre) * 0.1)
]

if(length(keep_cols) < length(covariate_names)) {
  cat("NA値の多い列を", length(covariate_names) - length(keep_cols), "個削除:\n")
  print(setdiff(covariate_names, keep_cols))
}

covariate_names <- keep_cols

# 共変量のNAがある行を除去
required_cols <- c(covariate_names, "treatment_group", "v001", "v005", "v022")
existing_required <- intersect(required_cols, names(df_pre))
complete_idx <- complete.cases(df_pre[, existing_required])

initial_rows <- nrow(df_pre)
df_pre <- df_pre[complete_idx, ]
cat("NA値を含む行を", initial_rows - nrow(df_pre), "行削除\n")
cat("最終的な介入前データサイズ:", nrow(df_pre), "行\n\n")

# ================================================================================
# 6. 多項ロジスティック回帰でPSM実装
# ================================================================================

if(length(covariate_names) > 0) {
  
  # PSM用データ準備
  psm_data <- df_pre[, c("treatment_group", covariate_names)]
  psm_data <- psm_data[complete.cases(psm_data), ]
  
  cat("PSM実行サンプル数:", nrow(psm_data), "\n")
  cat("PSM共変量数:", length(covariate_names), "\n")
  
  # 多項ロジスティック回帰の式
  psm_formula <- as.formula(
    paste("treatment_group ~", paste(covariate_names, collapse = " + "))
  )
  
  cat("\n多項ロジスティック回帰で傾向スコア推定中...\n")
  psm_model <- multinom(psm_formula, data = psm_data, trace = FALSE)
  
  # モデル要約
  cat("\n=== PSMモデル要約 ===\n")
  print(summary(psm_model))
  
  # 傾向スコア（各群の確率）を計算
  pscore_matrix <- predict(psm_model, type = "probs")
  
  # デバッグ情報
  cat("\npscore_matrix の次元:", dim(pscore_matrix), "\n")
  cat("treatment_group の水準:", levels(psm_data$treatment_group), "\n")
  cat("treatment_group の分布:\n")
  print(table(psm_data$treatment_group))
  
  # データフレーム形式に変換
  if(is.vector(pscore_matrix)) {
    # 2群の場合
    pscore_df <- data.frame(
      prob_0 = 1 - pscore_matrix,
      prob_1 = pscore_matrix
    )
    colnames(pscore_df) <- paste0("prob_", levels(psm_data$treatment_group))
  } else {
    # 3群以上の場合
    pscore_df <- as.data.frame(pscore_matrix)
    colnames(pscore_df) <- paste0("prob_", colnames(pscore_matrix))
  }
  
  cat("\n傾向スコア列名:\n")
  print(colnames(pscore_df))
  cat("\n傾向スコア要約統計:\n")
  print(summary(pscore_df))
  
  # ================================================================================
  # 7. IPTW重み計算
  # ================================================================================
  
  psm_data$iptw_weight <- numeric(nrow(psm_data))
  
  for(i in 1:nrow(psm_data)) {
    group_level <- as.character(psm_data$treatment_group[i])
    prob_col <- paste0("prob_", group_level)
    
    if(prob_col %in% colnames(pscore_df)) {
      prob_value <- pscore_df[i, prob_col]
      
      # 極小確率値の処理（ゼロ除算防止）
      if(prob_value > 0.001) {
        psm_data$iptw_weight[i] <- 1 / prob_value
      } else {
        psm_data$iptw_weight[i] <- 1 / 0.001  # 最大重み1000
        if(i <= 5) cat("警告: 極小確率値を調整（行", i, "、prob=", prob_value, "）\n")
      }
    } else {
      cat("エラー: 群", group_level, "の確率列", prob_col, "が見つかりません\n")
      psm_data$iptw_weight[i] <- 1
    }
  }
  
  cat("\n=== PSM完了 ===\n")
  cat("重みの要約統計:\n")
  print(summary(psm_data$iptw_weight))
  
  # 極端な重みの確認
  weight_quantiles <- quantile(psm_data$iptw_weight, c(0.01, 0.95, 0.99), na.rm = TRUE)
  cat("\n重みの分位点:\n")
  print(weight_quantiles)
  
  extreme_weights_99 <- psm_data$iptw_weight > weight_quantiles["99%"]
  extreme_weights_01 <- psm_data$iptw_weight < weight_quantiles["1%"]
  
  if(sum(extreme_weights_99, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
    cat("警告: 極端に大きな重み（99th超）が", 
        sum(extreme_weights_99, na.rm = TRUE), "個あります\n")
  }
  
  if(sum(extreme_weights_01, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
    cat("警告: 極端に小さな重み（1st未満）が", 
        sum(extreme_weights_01, na.rm = TRUE), "個あります\n")
  }
  
  # ================================================================================
  # 8. 元のdf_preにIPTW重みをマージ
  # ================================================================================
  
  df_pre_temp <- df_pre[complete.cases(df_pre[, c(covariate_names, "treatment_group")]), ]
  df_pre_temp$iptw_weight <- psm_data$iptw_weight
  
  df_pre$iptw_weight <- NA
  df_pre[rownames(df_pre_temp), "iptw_weight"] <- df_pre_temp$iptw_weight
  
  cat("\nIPTW重みを元データにマージ完了\n")
  cat("重み付き観測数:", sum(!is.na(df_pre$iptw_weight)), "/", nrow(df_pre), "\n")
  
  # ================================================================================
  # 9. サンプリングウェイトとの結合
  # ================================================================================
  
  df_pre$sampling_weight_norm <- df_pre$v005 / 1000000
  df_pre$w_combined <- df_pre$iptw_weight * df_pre$sampling_weight_norm
  
  # トリミング（1st - 99th percentile）
  weight_quantiles_combined <- quantile(df_pre$w_combined, c(0.01, 0.99), na.rm = TRUE)
  df_pre$w_combined_trimmed <- pmax(
    pmin(df_pre$w_combined, weight_quantiles_combined[2]), 
    weight_quantiles_combined[1]
  )
  
  cat("\n=== 最終重みの要約統計 ===\n")
  cat("Combined weight (IPTW × sampling):\n")
  print(summary(df_pre$w_combined))
  cat("\nTrimmed weight (1st-99th percentile):\n")
  print(summary(df_pre$w_combined_trimmed))
  
  # ================================================================================
  # 10. バランスチェック関数定義
  # ================================================================================
  
  calculate_smd_robust <- function(data, group_var, vars) {
    results <- data.frame(
      variable = character(0),
      smd = numeric(0),
      mean_control = numeric(0),
      mean_treated = numeric(0),
      var_type = character(0),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    
    for(var in vars) {
      if(!var %in% names(data)) next
      
      tryCatch({
        control_data <- data[data[[group_var]] == 0, var]
        treated_data <- data[data[[group_var]] == 1, var]
        
        if(length(control_data) == 0 || length(treated_data) == 0) next
        
        var_class <- class(data[[var]])[1]
        
        # 数値変数
        if(var_class %in% c("numeric", "integer")) {
          mean_c <- mean(control_data, na.rm = TRUE)
          mean_t <- mean(treated_data, na.rm = TRUE)
          var_c <- var(control_data, na.rm = TRUE)
          var_t <- var(treated_data, na.rm = TRUE)
          
          if(is.na(mean_c) || is.na(mean_t) || is.na(var_c) || is.na(var_t)) next
          
          if(var_c + var_t > 0) {
            smd <- abs((mean_t - mean_c) / sqrt((var_t + var_c) / 2))
          } else {
            smd <- abs(mean_t - mean_c)
          }
          
          results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
            variable = var, smd = smd,
            mean_control = mean_c, mean_treated = mean_t,
            var_type = "numeric", stringsAsFactors = FALSE
          ))
          
        # バイナリ変数
        } else if(var_class == "factor" && nlevels(data[[var]]) == 2) {
          levels_var <- levels(data[[var]])
          positive_level <- levels_var[2]
          
          prop_c <- mean(control_data == positive_level, na.rm = TRUE)
          prop_t <- mean(treated_data == positive_level, na.rm = TRUE)
          
          pooled_var <- prop_c * (1 - prop_c) + prop_t * (1 - prop_t)
          if(pooled_var > 0) {
            smd <- abs((prop_t - prop_c) / sqrt(pooled_var / 2))
          } else {
            smd <- abs(prop_t - prop_c)
          }
          
          results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
            variable = var, smd = smd,
            mean_control = prop_c, mean_treated = prop_t,
            var_type = "binary", stringsAsFactors = FALSE
          ))
          
        # カテゴリ変数
        } else if(var_class == "factor" && nlevels(data[[var]]) > 2) {
          levels_var <- levels(data[[var]])
          smd_max <- 0
          
          for(level in levels_var) {
            prop_c <- mean(control_data == level, na.rm = TRUE)
            prop_t <- mean(treated_data == level, na.rm = TRUE)
            
            pooled_var <- prop_c * (1 - prop_c) + prop_t * (1 - prop_t)
            if(pooled_var > 0) {
              smd_level <- abs((prop_t - prop_c) / sqrt(pooled_var / 2))
            } else {
              smd_level <- abs(prop_t - prop_c)
            }
            
            smd_max <- max(smd_max, smd_level)
          }
          
          mean_c <- mean(as.numeric(as.factor(control_data)), na.rm = TRUE)
          mean_t <- mean(as.numeric(as.factor(treated_data)), na.rm = TRUE)
          
          results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
            variable = var, smd = smd_max,
            mean_control = mean_c, mean_treated = mean_t,
            var_type = "categorical", stringsAsFactors = FALSE
          ))
        }
        
      }, error = function(e) {})
    }
    
    return(results)
  }
  
  # ================================================================================
  # 11. バランスチェック実行
  # ================================================================================
  
  df_pre_balance_check <- df_pre[!is.na(df_pre$iptw_weight), ]
  
  cat("\n=== バランスチェック開始 ===\n")
  cat("対象サンプル数:", nrow(df_pre_balance_check), "\n")
  cat("共変量数:", length(covariate_names), "\n")
  
  balance_before <- calculate_smd_robust(
    df_pre_balance_check, 
    "treatment_group", 
    covariate_names
  )
  
  cat("\n=== バランスチェック（Before PSM） ===\n")
  
  if(nrow(balance_before) > 0) {
    cat("計算成功した変数数:", nrow(balance_before), "/", length(covariate_names), "\n")
    cat("Mean SMD:", round(mean(balance_before$smd, na.rm=TRUE), 4), "\n")
    cat("Median SMD:", round(median(balance_before$smd, na.rm=TRUE), 4), "\n")
    cat("Max SMD:", round(max(balance_before$smd, na.rm=TRUE), 4), "\n")
    cat("SMD < 0.1:", sum(balance_before$smd < 0.1, na.rm=TRUE), "/", nrow(balance_before), "\n")
    cat("SMD < 0.05:", sum(balance_before$smd < 0.05, na.rm=TRUE), "/", nrow(balance_before), "\n")
    
    cat("\n変数型別の内訳:\n")
    print(table(balance_before$var_type))
    
    cat("\nTop 10 worst balanced variables:\n")
    balance_sorted <- balance_before[order(-balance_before$smd), ]
    print(head(balance_sorted[, c("variable", "smd", "var_type")], 10))
  } else {
    cat("エラー: SMD計算が成功した変数が0個です\n")
  }
  
  # ================================================================================
  # 12. 結果の保存
  # ================================================================================
  
  saveRDS(psm_model, file.path(gdrive_dir, "output", "psm_model.rds"))
  saveRDS(df_pre, file.path(gdrive_dir, "output", "df_pre_weighted.rds"))
  
  if(nrow(balance_before) > 0) {
    saveRDS(balance_before, file.path(gdrive_dir, "output", "balance_before.rds"))
  }
  
  cat("\n=== PSM処理完了 ===\n")
  cat("- PSMモデル保存: psm_model.rds\n")
  cat("- 重み付きデータ保存: df_pre_weighted.rds\n")
  if(nrow(balance_before) > 0) {
    cat("- バランス結果保存: balance_before.rds\n")
  }
  
  # ================================================================================
  # 13. 可視化（オプション）
  # ================================================================================
  
  if(nrow(balance_before) > 0) {
    library(ggplot2)
    
    # SMDヒストグラム
    p_smd <- ggplot(balance_before, aes(x = smd)) +
      geom_histogram(bins = 20, alpha = 0.7, fill = "skyblue", color = "black") +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0.1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0.05, color = "green", linetype = "dotted") +
      labs(
        title = "Distribution of SMD (Before PSM)",
        x = "SMD", y = "Count",
        caption = "Red: 0.1 (acceptable) | Green: 0.05 (excellent)"
      ) +
      theme_minimal()
    
    print(p_smd)
    
    cat("\n=== 可視化完了 ===\n")
  }
  
  # ================================================================================
  # 14. サマリー出力
  # ================================================================================
  
  cat("\n")
  cat(paste(rep("=", 70), collapse = ""), "\n")
  cat("PSM分析サマリー\n")
  cat(paste(rep("=", 70), collapse = ""), "\n")
  cat("サンプルサイズ:\n")
  cat("  - 介入前データ:", nrow(df_pre), "行\n")
  cat("  - PSM実行:", nrow(psm_data), "行\n")
  cat("  - Control:", sum(df_pre$treatment_group == 0, na.rm=TRUE), 
      "/ Treated1:", sum(df_pre$treatment_group == 1, na.rm=TRUE),
      "/ Treated2:", sum(df_pre$treatment_group == 2, na.rm=TRUE), "\n")
  cat("\nPSM共変量:\n")
  cat("  - 使用変数数:", length(covariate_names), "個\n")
  cat("  - メディエーター除外:", length(mediator_vars), "個\n")
  cat("\nIPTW重み:\n")
  cat("  - 中央値:", round(median(df_pre$iptw_weight, na.rm=TRUE), 3), "\n")
  cat("  - 最大値:", round(max(df_pre$iptw_weight, na.rm=TRUE), 3), "\n")
  cat("\n")
  if(nrow(balance_before) > 0) {
    cat("バランスチェック:\n")
    cat("  - 平均SMD:", round(mean(balance_before$smd, na.rm=TRUE), 4), "\n")
    cat("  - SMD<0.1:", sum(balance_before$smd < 0.1, na.rm=TRUE), "/", 
        nrow(balance_before), "\n")
  }
  cat(paste(rep("=", 70), collapse = ""), "\n")

} else {
  stop("エラー: 選択された共変量がありません。")
}

```
